title: Abro Ne Bayie 2
plotSummary: The pastor is shamed by a demon lady that comes in his bedroom (a pigeon is thrown the window and it morphs into her). He can no longer help our hero Brother Vincent. Not is all well for Dufie and Natasha however, as Vincent gets sick and is taken to the hospital. Vincent's father is very suspicious, and on the advice of the doctor takes Vincent to a Prophet, who sees the witch and can do nothing. At some point the father figures out what happened to Vincent, and the witch shows up (a turkey is dropped off the roof, and it morphs into her) and she throws fireballs at him. Then Vincent is taken to a evangelist priest where a 10 minute laser and fireball ensues as the witch shows up to keep him from being saved. Pure awesome. Dufie is now a more powerful as her soul was taken by the witch, and Natasha is saved by angels before she is killed by the witch.

Abena disobeys her father Addey and, with Bob, the poor young man she loves, elopes to Accra where things worsen.

title: The 2 Pilots

title: African Kung-Fu Nazis
plotSummary: Unlike what history books tell us, Adolf Hitler did not commit suicide in his bunker, but instead fled to the African continent in his submarine. Teaming up with his new right hand, infamous Japanese military leader Hideki Tojo and the brutal Horse-Man Göring, he plans on conquering the world once again - starting in Ghana. With the might of his loyal (although brainwashed) Ghan-Aryans and his superhuman Karate-Powers, Hitler destroys the African Kung-Fu school of the shadow snake, killing its leader. Grieving for his master, Kung-Fu disciple Addae seeks revenge by participating in Hitler's martial arts tournament. Will he find the strength of body and mind to defeat the evil dictator?

title: Top Model Ghana
plotSummary:
Top Model Ghana, was a weekly one-hour reality television series produced by 702 Productions, Ltd., and was aired on GTV. Inspired by but not licensed by ANTM, the objective of this program was to raise the caliber of young models in the country and enhancing the international perception of Ghanaian models. The grand prize was a working opportunity with a California modeling agency which was won by Mabel in the first and so far only Cycle.

Auditions were held all through the state of Ghana where Ghanaians were called for casting. Applicants were required to be from 18 to 24 years old at the time of application and at least 5'7" in height, to be eligible to meet the character criteria as set by Producer.

For 8 weeks, the 13 finalists lived in a house equipped with cameras and microphones. They were also evaluated by a panel of judges on both their filmed interactions and performance in challenges. These judges, including fashion industry experts, agency representatives, photographers and a weekly guest judge eliminated one contestant each week until a winner emerged.

Each episode targeted a particular life skill and modeling requirement. Contestant's knowledge and familiarity with subject matter were tested in a challenge. Aspiring models were evaluated based on their performance in the challenges.

title: All that Glitters

title: YODO SERIES

Where Teenagers are unable to speak up against such Abuse because of fear and threats. The rising cases of sexual abuse, substance abuse, and other related forms of exploitation have become major contributors to mental health challenges among Ghanaian teenagers. One key solution is enabling young people to feel safe and supported enough to speak up to a teacher, guardian, or friend. Unfortunately, fear, threats, and intimidation from abusers often silence them. So Yodo Series was made to address that gap by educating, encouraging, and inspiring students to break the silence.

title: YOLO

plotSummary: Universities in Nigeria and Ghana have been plagued by stories of sexual harassment by lecturers and professors for decades. Allegations include a wide array of abuses, from blackmailing students for sex in exchange for marks and admission to lewd comments and grooming. After gathering dozens of testimonies, BBC Africa Eye sent undercover journalists posing as students inside the University of Lagos (UNILAG) and the University of Ghana to capture footage of the sexual harassment. Reporter Kiki Mordi, who knows first-hand how devastating sexual harassment can be, reveals what happens behind the closed doors of some of West Africa’s most prestigious universities.

title: When Women Speak
plotSummary: Traces the stories of 16 Ghanaian women who came of age in the 1960s and 1970s. It follows their experiences (as told in their own words) as Ghana passed through periods of military, single-party and multi-party rule. These women were prominent in public life – in the law, the media, academia, politics, and various governmental and non-governmental organisations for women. Their stories tell us about the issues around which women mobilised, and their modes of activism and advocacy at home and abroad, during the ‘lost decades’. They challenge the popular perception that gender activism is a foreign import, which came from ‘the West’ and found its way to Ghana with the restoration of multi-party democracy in 1992.

plotSummary: Untitled is a poetry animation that explores the issues of sexual harassment in women. 13 women share their experiences of how they felt. The poem was first published on Glasnost and the author remains anonymous. THis short intends to bring awareness of different forms of sexual harassment that many women and men face at different ages.

title: Dictatrix
plotSummary: Nana Yaa-Ghana's first female president-is thrust into a deadly web of political intrigue that threatens not only her power but her life.

title: 2016: Part 2
plotSummary: As the aliens continue their murderous rampage through Ghana, the scientist builds something that might hold them at bay.

title: Cookie Box
tagline: A TALE OF COURAGE AND COMPASSION
plotSummary: Palesa, a graduate migrant working as a hospital cleaner, wants to follow her true calling, risk everything, and help Maria, a quadriplegic patient.

title: My Very Ghanaian Wedding
plotSummary: A Ghanaian Romantic-Comedy

title: Jaguar
plotSummary: A Berlinale FIPRESCI Special Mentioned short musical documentary.

title: Aloevera
plotSummary: In a town divided into two opposing groups, a man and woman from opposite sides fall for each other. But can love transcend the line that separates them?

title: The Northern King
plotSummary: Battle lines are drawn when two childhood friends are pitted against each other in the battle of a life time as Amin, a former United States Airman returns to his home country to discover his best friend has become a drug king. After being put in charge of the case, Amin vows to bring down Mannahn. But it took great sacrifice to become the King. And the King will not go down without a fight.

title: Tsutsue
plotSummary: Set in a small Ghanaian town at the edge of a large landfill site that spills into the ocean, the sons of a fisherman, Sowah and Okai, struggle to cope with loss of their eldest brother who drowned during a fishing expedition. Haunted by his demise, Okai believes their brother is still out there…

title: Azonto Ghost
plotSummary: A father leaves his a large amount of his inheritance to one of his children, an Azonto-loving man named Liwin, causing conflict between his siblings. Liwin is eventually murdered, but returns as a ghost with killer dance moves.

title: Genesis of the Ashantis
plotSummary: Once Upon A Time, The Great Ashanti Tribe and Guans in Ghana, Africa went to war because of the Golden Horn. Whoever gets the Golden Horn will be Supreme among all the Tribes, but the Prophecy has it that only the Chosen One can hold the Golden Horn...between the Prince of the Ashantis and the Guans who is the Chosen One and who will win this battle?

title: Chocolate City
plotSummary: This story captures many students' lives; going about their day to day lives with no regard for others, no realisation that there are consequences to every action! Be captivated with all the deceit, lies, fake friends, and tricks from all the characters you meet!

title: How to Break Your Virginity
plotSummary: A young man's quest to lose his virginity spirals into a hilarious journey of self-discovery. Meet Jeffery—awkward, endearing, and desperate to shed his V-card. After his fake sex stories backfire at work, his friends set him up on a series of cringeworthy dates, including a mix-up with a gay man that leads to unexpected revelations. As Jeffery stumbles through one absurd failure after another, he begins to realize that sex isn’t the answer—self-love and connection are. How to Break Your Virginity is a sharp, heartfelt comedy about identity, friendship, and learning to love yourself, no matter who you are.

title: Public Toilet Africa
plotSummary: When reticent Ama returns to the city where she was gifted to a white art collector as a little girl, the quest to reclaim her stolen childhood quickly goes into a tailspin when she recruits an ex-lover on her mission. Escaping the city on a remote country road, their journey is beset with a series of bizarre encounters as their fate is tied to that of two passengers they pick up.

title: Knotless
plotSummary: When a Ghanaian-American woman relocates to Ghana in search of community and belonging, a friend’s wedding seems like the perfect opportunity to build connection, until a series of unsettling encounters forces her to confront the country’s unspoken beliefs and practices.

title: Children of the Mountain
plotSummary: Against the picturesque Ghanaian backdrop, Children of the Mountain is an honest exploration of a mother’s will in the face of much adversity. When her baby is born with a cleft lip, cerebral palsy, and Down syndrome, Essuman is led to believe that she has a ‘dirty womb.’ Her promising future as a wife and mother is shattered as her lover disowns her and the community eyes her with suspicion.

title: Away Bus
plotSummary: Two sisters orchestrate a bus robbery to raise money to save their dying mother.

cast.name: Akwasi Boadi (Akrobeto)
cast.image: data:image/jpeg;base64, Boadi, known as Akrobeto, is a Ghanaian actor, comedian and TV presenter. He has been featured in over 100 Kumawood movies and is known for the unusually large size of his nostrils.

title: Pregnant Warrior 2
plotSummary: After the painful losses of the first battle, Nafisa and her family gather to mourn their loved ones. But their enemies are not finished. Using dark rituals and human sacrifice, the fallen warriors are brought back to life. Filled with anger and revenge, they return to destroy Nafisa and her people. A new and deadly battle begins. Nafisa is no longer pregnant, but two other pregnant women rise as warriors to defend their village. They fight with courage and strength, but the enemies use a cruel new strategy. In the end, sacrifices are made, lives are lost, and the war leaves deep pain behind.  Pregnant Warrior 2 is an emotional African action story about bravery, revenge, and the heavy price of freedom.

title: No Tears for Ananse
plotSummary: The adventures of Ananse, the spider-man and brother of the god of the sky as well as a symbol of skill and shrewdness and a classic character in traditional Akan legends. The first feature film made in Ghana

title: Last Night
plotSummary: A man's desire for a beautiful stranger leads him down a dark and dangerous path, where he discovers a terrifying secret lurking beneath the surface as he searches for the woman who stole his heart.

title: Locked-In
plotSummary: Two friends Mike and Kwesi take a journey to Ghana to seek pastures new. While en-route to complete a lucrative land deal, they encounter an array of issues.

title: Coming to Africa: Welcome to Ghana
plotSummary: For the first time since her divorce, Akosua, an African schoolteacher, is in love again and preparing to fulfill her lifelong dream of moving to the US with her new American boyfriend, Adrian, who is struggling to gain acceptance from her family. When Adrian's brother Buck arrives in Ghana looking to make business connections, he becomes a target for a desperate gangster.

title: Fix Us
plotSummary: Three actresses must each resolve their conflicting romances to prevent their personal drama from going public and wrecking their careers.

title: A Country Called Ghana
plotSummary: A foreigner led by some Nigerians enters a small Ghanaian village with the intention of stealing something precious from them. Will they succeed in their quest?

title: The Cursed Ones
plotSummary: The Cursed Ones tells the story of a disillusioned reporter and an idealistic young pastor, who fight to free a girl accused of witchcraft from the clutches of a system of corruption and superstition in the heart of West Africa.

title: Adams Apples: The Family Ties
plotSummary: It is set in the hustle and bustle of the city of Accra and its suburbs with glimpses of the exciting metropolis of London.

title: Sidechic Gang
plotSummary: Three female friends find out they can make fortunes from exposing cheating husbands and boyfriends after making tons of cash unexpectedly from reporting a cheating husband to the wife. They quit their ushering job to set up "Sidechic Gang" - an agency solely dedicated to clamping down the side chick menace.

title: The Return of Beyonce 2
plotSummary: Beyonce finally gets to wed the man of her dreams & something has gotten into the way once more. Can she be able to dig her way out of it per usual, even when past enemies and unforeseen situations arise that put her evil plans to a halt? Will she ever get her Prince Charming after all?

title: The Whites of Our Eyes
plotSummary: A short documentary film that follows Dr. Yaba Blay as she returns to her familial homeland of Ghana to explore the relationships between beauty, bodies and b/Blackness. In addition to recreating the groundbreaking Clark Doll Test among schoolchildren, the film follows a young hustler as he prepares for his community’s annual harvest festival by bleaching his skin. Amid the ghosts of colonialism and the gods of whiteness, The Whites of Our Eyes questions ideas and ideals of beauty in contemporary Ghana.

title: Agony of the Christ
plotSummary: A young man ran away from his village because the traditional priestess wanted him killed. He was saved by Christians who trained him in the knowledge of Christianity and he became born again. He returned to his village where they were worshippers of lesser gods. His task of converting everyone in the village into a Christian was thwarted by the priestess of the land, who did not allow that to happen thereby engaging him in spiritual battle.

title: Keteke
plotSummary: It's the 1980s in rural Ghana, and Atswei is heavily pregnant and desperate to get to Ateke to deliver her baby. But when she and husband Boi miss the morning train — the only means of transport to the city — the hapless couple are left stranded in the blazing sun with only Boi's boombox for encouragement. A madcap race against time follows in this colorful screwball comedy, with wry but affectionate nods to Ghanaian traditions and gender dynamics.

title: Nakom
plotSummary: Upon his father's sudden death, a talented medical student returns to his home village in Ghana to fight for his family's survival.

title: My White Baby
plotSummary: Me Broni Ba is a lyrical portrait of hair salons in Kumasi, Ghana. The tangled legacy of European colonialism in Africa is evoked through images of women practicing hair braiding on discarded white baby dolls from the West. The film unfolds through a series of vignettes, set against a child's story of migrating from Ghana to the United States. The film uncovers the meaning behind the Akan term of endearment, me broni ba, which means “my white baby.”

title: Princess Tyra
plotSummary: Princess Tyra is engaged according to tradition to Prince Kay who has his eyes on one of Princess Tyra's maids.

title: E-Life
tagline: What happens when your computer dies?
plotSummary: Computers, smart phones, and tablets are now a part of our daily lives. They have revolutionised the way we work, the way we communicate and the way we view the world. But what happens to our old phone when we upgrade? Where does our broken computer go after we throw it out? 'e-Life' explores what happens to our electrical goods when we throw them away and exposes some unpleasant (and perhaps unknown) truths about the detrimental affects e-waste has on people's health, the environment and the economy. From consumers in the UK to the recyclers in the dumps of Ghana, the documentary will follow the journey of our e-waste. We will examine current manufacturing and disposal processes and also assess the burden the boom in electronic goods is placing on global resources. 'e-Life' will be an objective portrayal of the problem of e-waste that documents the issue through carefully crafted cinematography.

title: Echo Chamber
plotSummary: After hearing the passing of his mother, Fiifi, a 20-year-old Lv200 Industrial Arts student, suddenly starts having panic attacks and begins to see and hear malicious apparitions. He goes to see a therapist, Dr. Baaba Annan, a 30-year-old therapist.  With her help, Fiifi dives into his mind to find the source of his apparitions, and is faced with a choice: succumb to the torment of his haunting visions or confront the echoes and overcome them with a new voice.

title: Slumber Party Murders
plotSummary: A college graduation party takes a dark turn when people begin to die mysteriously

title: B14
plotSummary: Rival gangs fight over a cocaine shipment. One of the gangs, led by a ruthless woman named Lan Di, has a superhumanly powered assassin named Scorpion at her disposal.

title: Hamile: The Tongo Hamlet
plotSummary: An adaptation of the play by William Shakespeare, which takes place in the home of the Frafra people, in the far north of Ghana. Performed by students of the University of Ghana School of Music and Drama.

title: The Witches of Gambaga
tagline: The Witches Of Gambaga is the extraordinary story of a community of women condemned to live as witches in Northern Ghana.
plotSummary: The Witches Of Gambaga is the extraordinary story of a community of women condemned to live as witches in Northern Ghana. Every year in this part of Ghana, hundreds of women endure communal and domestic violence as a result of traditional religious beliefs that demonize women. These beliefs, combined with decades of poor health and educational standards, mean women inhabit a world where it is believed that nothing – not even illness or death – happens by chance. For over a century, women from all over the northern region have found refuge in a camp in the town of Gambaga, where they live under the protection of the chief, Gambarrana, the custodian of one of four places of sanctuary for women condemned of witchcraft. Made over the course of 5 years, this disturbing expose is the product of a collaboration between members of the 100-strong community of 'witches' and women’s movement activists determined to end abusive practices and improve women’s lives in Africa.

title: Gold Coast Lounge
plotSummary: In post-independence Ghana, the son of a crime family juggles power struggles and a murder case as the government threatens to shut down their lounge.

title: The Groomsmen
plotSummary: After proposing to Maya in just 4 months of meeting her, Mark realizes he has little knowledge of his betrothed and tries all he can to know his wife to be. In just a few days to the wedding, he invites four of Maya’s ex boyfriends for a weekend get away, to tell him more about his wife to be.

title: Afronauts
plotSummary: 16th July 1969: America prepares to launch Apollo 11. Thousands of kilometers away, a ragtag group of Zambian exiles is trying to beat America to the Moon.

title: Sin City
plotSummary: A busy couple tries to give their love life a boost by taking an impromptu weekend trip only to find their relationship tested in unexpected ways.

title: Beyonce: The President's Daughter
plotSummary: Beyonce vs. Ciara.. Beyonce', the president's daughter meets Raj at the Super Market and falls in Love with him. Raj is engaged to be married to Ciara, but Beyonce doesn't intend for that to stand in her way.

title: 2016: Part 1
plotSummary: In 2010, a scientist discovers aliens in orbit that resemble a cross between H.R. Giger's famous creation and Predator who want to invade Earth. They choose to start their invasion in Ghana because it is the most peaceful nation on the planet. The murderous aliens claim that they will have the entire planet colonized by the year 2016.

title: The Return of Beyonce
tagline: This is a CLASSIC GHANAIAN LOVE STORY
plotSummary: Beyonce manages to reconcile with Raj after Ciara's death and they marry. During the wedding, Beyonce is shot and gains a head injury that causes partial amnesia. Raj deals with her father's fury and his demands for answers.

title: Pray the Devil Back to Hell
plotSummary: Pray the Devil Back to Hell chronicles the remarkable story of the Liberian women who came together to end a bloody civil war and bring peace to their shattered country.

title: Nine
plotSummary: Driven by grief, a U.S. detective's hunt for his daughter's murderer leads him to Africa, where he, along with a group of assassins, unravels a chilling string of witchcraft-related killings.

title: The December Blues
tagline: WHERE CINEMA MEETS FEELING, AND DETTY DECEMBER FINDS NEW MEANING.
plotSummary: Set in Accra during the heart of 𝘿𝙚𝙩𝙩𝙮 𝘿𝙚𝙘𝙚𝙢𝙗𝙚𝙧, the story follows Kofi, a Ghanaian boy, and Bianca, a girl from London, as their worlds collide in a haze of rhythm, heat, and emotion. What begins as a spark of attraction becomes a deeper reflection on what love means when it isn't meant to last.

title: The Burial of Kojo
plotSummary: A man is trapped in a mine shaft by his vengeful brother while his daughter embarks on a magical journey to rescue him.

title: The Fisherman
plotSummary: A retired traditional fisherman from Ghana. His life takes a whimsical turn when he is forced into retirement and partnered with a sarcastic talking fish, leading him on an adventure to Accra. Joined by his three quirky "Associates," they pursue their dream of owning a boat. Filled with laughter, magic, and the vibrant culture of Ghana, The Fisherman is a delightful tale of family, dreams, and the enduring spirit of a true fisherman.

title: Paradise
plotSummary: In the wake of his father’s disappearance at sea, Kojo, a young Ghanaian, is drawn into a world of street gangs and deception. Meanwhile, in Quebec, Tony discovers his mother’s relationship with a mysterious sailor who may hold the key to finding the father he’s never met.

title: John & John
tagline: Two con men, a bag of fake gold, and a hotel room full of eccentric liars.
plotSummary: John and John is a sensational Kumawood comedic blockbuster. Two con artists, John (played by Kalybos) and John (played by Lil Win), retrieve a bag of valuable diamonds only to find themselves stranded at a remote luxury hotel. When other eccentric guests, gold diggers, and corrupt security personnel arrive, a hilarious, tense game of bluffing and comedic tricks begins.

faqs.answer: It is a hybrid cross-over comedy featuring major stars from both language sectors.
faqs.question: Is this a Kumawood or Ghallywood movie?

quotes: "Look John, fake diamonds are like a fake smile. They only work if you stay in the shadows."
trivia: This film features an iconic cross-over cast, bringing Accra's English sector stars together with Kumasi's indigenous Twi sector stars.
It broke opening weekend box office records at Silverbird Cinemas in Accra.

criticReviews.snippet: A historic comedic cross-over that proves Kumawood and Ghallywood are at their absolute best when united.

userReviews.title: Absolute laugh riot!
userReviews.content: Lil Win and Kalybos are the best comedic duo ever. My family and I laughed from the first minute to the last. Highly recommend!

title: Single & Married
tagline: The grass is always greener on the other side, until you cross the fence.
plotSummary: Produced by Yvonne Nelson, this sensational blockbuster tells the interlocking stories of three friends: a beautifully married woman dealing with her husband's infidelities, a single woman desperate to find a husband, and a carefree woman who refuses to settle down. Together, they explore the hilarious, dramatic, and painful realities of modern love in high-society Ghana.

faqs.answer: Yes, a sequel titled 'Single, Married & Complicated' was successfully released in 2014.
faqs.question: Is there a sequel?

quotes: "A married man is like a library book. You can browse, but you cannot take him home."
trivia: It won Best Picture at the Ghana Movie Awards in 2012, highlighting Yvonne Nelson's immense capabilities as both a producer and leading actress.
Filmed on location in various luxurious estates across East Legon, Accra.

criticReviews.snippet: A highly entertaining, glossy drama that captures the vibrant social complexities of modern Accra couples.

userReviews.title: Majid is so good at playing a bad husband!
userReviews.content: I loved this movie! Majid Michel and Yvonne Nelson have unmatched romantic chemistry. Super funny but has deep lessons.

title: Adams Apples
tagline: Ten chapters. Three daughters. One chaotic, beautiful Accra year.
plotSummary: Adams Apples is a legendary ten-chapter cinematic serial following the lives of the prominent Adams family in Accra. It centers on three beautiful daughters and their fierce, ambitious mother as they navigate failing marriages, corporate rivalries, unexpected pregnancies, and the beautiful, complex struggles of upper-class Ghanaian womanhood.

faqs.answer: The hit title song was composed and sung by popular artist Efya.
faqs.question: Who composed the theme song?

quotes: "Jennifer, in this family, we do not settle. We conquer."
trivia: Adams Apples was released as a ten-chapter monthly movie theater serial, causing massive box office queues in Accra throughout 2011.
The theme song became one of the most played radio tracks in West Africa.

criticReviews.snippet: Sparrow Productions hits a grand slam. Technically flawless, emotionally deep, and visually stunning.

userReviews.title: Incredible serial!
userReviews.content: I watched every single chapter in the cinemas. The chemistry between the sisters is beautiful. Joselyn Dumas was born for this role.
